activity_summary: You stayed home from the afternoon Shrew. You said the jaw is well, and you ate. The loaf was a penny and a full thumb short of the notch. You would not explain the boy, and you would not explain the morning. The red bundle stays tied. Mistress Ansell offered dullness as a kindness, and you took it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the afternoon and refused the story of the boy.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Took the threepence, declined the plot, and offered to be dull on his behalf.
